title: trigonostemon lanceolatus
intro: Trigonostemon lanceolatus, commonly known as Lance-leaf Trigonostemon, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Trigonostemon lanceolatus include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and potential health benefits of this plant species.
